description: What agencies plan to procure (annual procurement plans, PCA, on PNCP), before the tender opens: item, agency, quantity, estimated value and desired date. Free. Only the current version of each plan; without `ano`, from the current year on. To know when the tender opens, create an alert with the same terms (`/api/alertas`). `Accept: text/html` opens the Planos de compras tab with the terms.

ano.description: Plan year (optional; the default is from the current year on).

name: procurement_plans
title: Procurement plans
